title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - ChangeRequest
description: Change Request is a type of request which can be used for the management and control of Change Management process -within a service provider organisation or -between a customer and a service provider or -between a service provider and a partner and vice versa. (TM Forum TMF655 API ChangeManagement 4.0.0, Swagger definition ChangeRequest; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:ChangeRequest:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ChangeRequest'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:ChangeRequest:<tmfId>. Identifier of a Change Request. It is created on repository side (a Change Management system)
